body:
Makes sense the way that `can_process` is defined. 

However, the `ERR_FAIL_` has been here since Godot was made open source (first commit), and could be called into question.
Notably, the assumption of being in the tree on call is violated elsewhere, e.g. in `scene_tree.cpp`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/481f36ed20520db3195a09cc309abf48c03cf51a/scene/main/scene_tree.cpp#L1188

We'll discuss whether to change the behavior on the caller or callee site in the next core meeting.

You're right, independent from whether we want to make a change callee-side, fixing this problem takes priority.

I can confirm this is a safe change. `can_process` is non-virtual, so the `ERR_FAIL_COND` will indeed be triggered in call cases without this fix.
